command:
if mount -t tmpfs -o size=32k,mode=0700 tmpfs /etc/proxy-skills-network; then
 dd if=/dev/zero of=/etc/proxy-skills-network/fill bs=1024 count=24 2>/dev/null
 sh /tmp/skills-audit.hmOBIM/fixed-dae-openwrt.sh --watchdog
 rc=$?; echo injected_rc=$rc
 sha256sum /etc/config/firewall /etc/config/dhcp
 umount /etc/proxy-skills-network || exit 1
 [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]
else echo tmpfs_mount_blocked; exit 77; fi
